gloss: one's skill improves; to get better at

definitions.gloss: one's skill improves; to get better at
definitions.explanation: To improve at a skill or craft through practice, such as cooking, a sport or a trade. {腕|うで} here means skill.

examples.japanese: ⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{腕|うで}が{上|あ}がった⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}して→練習する：22991_renshuusuru⟧、⟦ギター→ギター：04461_gitaa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{腕|うで}が{上|あ}がった。
examples.english: By practicing every day, I got better at guitar.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{修業|しゅぎょう}→修業：16906_shugyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{重|かさ}ねる→重ねる：02039_kasaneru⟧うち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{職人|しょくにん}→職人：09868_shokunin⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{腕|うで}→腕：01006_ude⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぐんと⟦{上|あ}がった→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: As he kept up his training, his skill as a craftsman improved dramatically.

notes:
⟦{腕|うで}→腕：01006_ude⟧ means skill here, as in ⟦{腕|うで}→腕：01006_ude⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ (skilled) and ⟦{腕|うで}を{磨|みが}く→腕を磨く：07453_udewomigaku⟧ (to hone one's skill).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{腕|うで}が{上|あ}がる: to get better at ~
- ⟦{腕|うで}→腕：01006_ude⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧: to improve one's skill (transitive; also praise: ⟦{腕|うで}→腕：01006_ude⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げた→上げる：02443_ageru⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧)
- ⟦{腕|うで}→腕：01006_ude⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧: one's skill declines

WATCH OUT:
The literal meaning also exists: ⟦{肩|かた}→肩：02192_kata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}くて→痛い：01108_itai⟧{腕|うで}が{上|あ}がらない (my shoulder hurts so I can't raise my arm).
